sinopsis.es: La única película dirigida por Václav Havel, basada en su última obra literaria, es una reflexión autobiográfica y una libre interpretación de «El rey Lear», de Shakespeare y «El jardín de los cerezos», de Chéjov.
sinopsis.en: A bitter sweet comedy that follows a highly appointed Chancellor who set to step down from his position after years of service to his country. With just two last days left to enjoy his palatial villa before he is finally evicted, his situation gradually goes from bad to worse.
